edges.reason: nonReentrant modifier reads and writes rentrancy_lock to prevent nested calls.
Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier reads owner to compare with msg.sender.
msg.sender is assigned to owner in Ownable constructor.
msg.sender is compared to owner in onlyOwner.
msg.sender is assigned to investor in buy().
buy() requires now < 1507766400, introducing timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp feeds the timestamp_check unsafe operation.
buy() uses c_STQperETH as exchange rate multiplier.
buy() checks payment against c_MinInvestment.
m_token is the target contract of the external mint call.
m_funds is the target address of the external transfer call.
buy() calls m_token.mint() before forwarding funds.
buy() calls m_funds.transfer() as an external interaction.
buy() is guarded by the nonReentrant modifier.
fallback function calls buy().
transferOwnership is restricted by onlyOwner.
amIOwner is restricted by onlyOwner.
STQPreSale constructor invokes the Ownable constructor through inheritance.
constructor assigns m_token = STQToken(token).
constructor assigns m_funds = funds.
transferOwnership assigns owner = newOwner when newOwner is nonzero.
buy() assigns investor = msg.sender.
buy() assigns payment = msg.value.
buy() returns stq.
payment is passed into SafeMath.mul.
c_STQperETH is passed into SafeMath.mul as multiplier.
SafeMath.mul result is assigned to stq.
stq is passed as argument to m_token.mint.
investor is passed as recipient to m_token.mint.
payment is passed as value to m_funds.transfer.
